# `Q-7-5` — Inputs Span Multiple Projects

> Input paths belong to more than one Quarto project; render
> one project at a time.

## What this means

When you pass multiple input paths, Quarto resolves each one to
its enclosing project (the nearest ancestor directory with a
`_quarto.yml`). All inputs must resolve to the *same* project —
a render run carries one project's configuration, build
options, output directory, and so on. This error fires when at
least two of the paths land in different projects.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A glob expansion** that crossed a project boundary.
- **A script collecting files from multiple sibling
  directories**, each of which is its own Quarto project.

## How to fix

Render each project separately. If the files truly belong
together, restructure so they live under a single
`_quarto.yml`.
